Distribution. Madagascar. Taxonomic notes. This species is transferred into the genus Charagochilus based on the following characters: collum about 1.5 times as long as width of the antennal segment (Fig. 41 C); punctures on pronotum deep and rather large; preocular part of head short; claw without denticle; left paramere with flattened laterally, dolabriform hypophysis; apical margin of the theca with only one blade; vesica with the left carina, medial right lobe bearing lamellar medial spicule, with the posterior spicule lying between bases of the medial right and posterior right lobes, without anterior and posterior left lobes; the secondary gonopore with complete ring of concentrically curved spinulae.
